description: ShockGraph EC2 probe: reports only fixed presence flags. No input parameters.

runCommand: if timeout 8s docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo docker_daemon=ok; else echo docker_daemon=unavailable; fi
if timeout 8s docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo docker_compose=ok; else echo docker_compose=unavailable; fi
if [ -e "$deploy_root/.git" ]; then echo checkout=present; else echo checkout=missing; fi
if [ -f "$deploy_root/deploy/.env" ]; then echo deploy_env=present; else echo deploy_env=missing; fi
